title: AI Gateway Vertex AI auth headers: always drop client credentials before merging the GCP bearer token on Vertex delegates
answers: Claude Code routed through a Vertex AI endpoint fails with duplicate Authorization headers
Why does a Vertex AI MaaS endpoint use the client's token instead of the GCP OAuth token when called from Codex?
Where are inbound client auth headers stripped for Vertex AI requests?
Does the credential-agent carve-out still forward a client's API key on direct Anthropic endpoints?
body:
Path: Header merge for every request to a Vertex AI delegate, including chat, streaming, passthrough and proxy calls that carry inbound headers from a credential agent (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI); the merge happens in `mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:_VertexAIClaudeProvider._get_headers` and `_VertexAIMaaSProvider._get_headers`.
Rule: Both Vertex delegate `_get_headers` overrides call `mlflow/gateway/providers/base.py:_drop_client_auth_headers` on the inbound headers before calling `super()._get_headers`, regardless of the user agent. The credential-agent carve-out in `AnthropicProvider._get_headers` and `OpenAICompatibleProvider._get_headers` keeps the client's own `authorization` or `x-api-key`, which is never valid on Vertex.
Symptom: A Claude Code request through a Vertex AI Claude endpoint carried both the client's Authorization and the GCP bearer token, which Google rejects as duplicate headers; a MaaS request through a credential agent dropped the GCP token in favour of the client's token.
Constraints: Applies only to Vertex delegates; direct Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible providers keep the carve-out. Any new Vertex delegate method that forwards inbound headers must go through the same drop.
applies: Applies to Vertex AI Claude and MaaS delegate header construction when the caller is a credential agent.
says: Connecting Claude Code through our gateway Vertex Claude endpoint fails with duplicate authorization header errors.
Developer assistant requests to Vertex Claude models get rejected by Google for duplicate auth headers.
Calls from Codex to Vertex model endpoints fail because client credentials overwrite cloud platform tokens.
Allow coding assistants to authenticate against Vertex hosted Claude endpoints through the AI Gateway.
Strip incoming client API keys when routing AI Gateway requests to Google Cloud models.
search: In AI Gateway header merge for Vertex AI Claude and MaaS delegates (`_VertexAIClaudeProvider._get_headers` and `_VertexAIMaaSProvider._get_headers`), inbound client auth headers must be stripped via `mlflow/gateway/providers/base.py:_drop_client_auth_headers` before calling `super()._get_headers`, regardless of user agent. This prevents credential agents like Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI from forwarding client authorization or api-key headers that Google rejects as duplicates alongside GCP bearer tokens. Applies only to Vertex delegates, whereas direct `AnthropicProvider` and `OpenAICompatibleProvider` keep their credential-agent carve-out, and any new Vertex delegate method forwarding headers must apply the same drop.
